thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High: External probe failures detected in us-west-2 (region). probe_check: failed 47/50 in last 5m. links: https://monitoring.example.com/alerts/12345

alice: ack. I’m on-call for SRE this shift, starting investigation. Paging net oncall @bob.

bob: on it, looking at probe logs now. can you confirm if this is only synthetic probes or also customer traffic?

alice: synthetic first; quick look at ingress metrics shows small spike in 502s in us-west-2 for a subset of LB endpoints. Not global.

dave: seeing an increase in customer-reported errors from a handful of accounts in west coast datacenter. customer support queue has ~5 related tickets.

alice: ok marking potential customer impact. Status page draft: "Degraded: some customers in us-west-2 may see increased errors while we investigate." cc @carol for comms.

ops-bot: /incident create "US-WEST-2 probe failures" severity:high -> INCIDENT-20240308-01 created.

bob: digging into probe failures — probes use DNS name lb-us-west-2.example.net. DNS resolution looks ok from internal resolvers but probes are getting TLS handshake timeouts: `handshake_timeout` in probe logs. past ~30m.

eve: we rolled a small DNS TTL change earlier to help propagation (PR #2467). reverting DNS isn't trivial but worth checking.

alice: before rolling anything, let's verify telemetry. I'm not seeing host-level telemetry for some probe runners in us-west-2 — missing heartbeat from probe-runner-2a and 2b since ~09:22 UTC. Could be related to monitoring collector outage.

bob: hmm that suggests alerts could be false positives if probes are down. But customer 502s contradict that. running `curl -v https://lb-us-west-2.example.net/healthz` from a probe container:```
> GET /healthz
< HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
* Connection #0 to host lb-us-west-2.example.net left intact
```

alice: 504 from the LB. Checking upstream instances: many are marked unhealthy in the LB pool. healthcheck logs show backend failing TLS negotiation with `alert: unsupported_protocol` in the backend logs.

bob: quick hypothesis: recent edge TLS config change pushed a new cipher suite, some older backend VMs don't support it -> failing healthchecks. But why are probes missing heartbeat? possibly same config rollout impacted probe-runner service or its metrics exporter.

carol: I'm drafting customer comms. Need ETA for mitigation. can SRE provide expected timeline?

alice: immediate mitigation plan: 1) roll back the TLS cipher change to previous stable config on the LB for us-west-2 (fast). 2) bring probe-runner-2a/2b back into monitoring (restart exporter), but only after LB rollback to avoid churn. 3) failover critical traffic to us-east-1 if rollback takes >15m.

bob: starting rollback now. running `kubectl set env deployment/lb-config -n edge TLS_PROFILE=stable-202402` on the edge config plane. logs: ``kubectl apply... successful; propagation in progress``

incident-bot: Action recorded: rollback initiated by bob at 1710002130.

alice: LB config reported healthy after 90s. Re-running probes: `curl -v https://lb-us-west-2.example.net/healthz` -> HTTP 200 OK.

dave: support: customer tickets that reported errors are getting follow-ups: service restored for most; leaving one customer case open for deeper trace.

eve: restarted exporter on probe-runner-2a and 2b, heartbeats returned. monitoring now shows synthetic probe success rate back to baseline.

ops-bot: /incident update INCIDENT-20240308-01 "Rollback of TLS profile completed; probe-runner telemetry restored; customer impact limited to short window."

alice: handing over to carol for on-call overlap and post-incident actions. carol, next steps: postmortem, confirm whether the DNS TTL change correlated with config rollout timing, and add a guard in deploys to prevent simultaneous TLS and DNS TTL changes across regions.

carol: taking handoff. will create postmortem doc and schedule RCA. Please drop any logs or timeline entries here. :thumbsup:

alice: timeline notes: alert 1710001234 -> rollback started 1710002130 -> rollback complete 1710002250 -> probes healthy 1710002400. Putting final status as RESOLVED in 30m if no regression.

incident-bot: Incident INCIDENT-20240308-01 marked Resolved by carol at 1710008234.

carol: closing notes: false-positive risk was increased by missing probe-runner telemetry which made early alerts noisy. Action items: (1) add probe-runner exporter HA checks, (2) add deploy guard rails to prevent TLS & DNS simultaneous changes, (3) add a synthetic cross-region check to detect telemetry blindspots during config rollouts. I'll post the postmortem link when created.

alice: thanks everyone, nice quick rollback.

bob: looks good. logging followups in ENG-INFRA backlog.

carol: assigning tickets: ENG-3122 (postmortem), ENG-3123 (deploy guard), ENG-3124 (probe HA).
